events.excerpt: **Correction first:** as flagged, W2 and W3 already existed from the earlier Stage 1 run (never actually abandoned — the "stop if W1 *and* W2 both reduce PR-AUC" rule didn't trigger since W1 improved PR-AUC, so I ran all three then). No retraining was needed; all work below is diagnostics on the existing `_w6`/`_w10` models. One correction to my own earlier reporting: **W1 did NOT run the full 50 epochs as I stated before** — checking the logs now shows it stopped at epoch 49 (best epoch 37, patience 12 exhausted: 37+12=49). W2 stopped at epoch 35 (best epoch 23). W3 stopped at epoch 19 (best epoch 7). All three genuinely triggered EarlyStopping.
